title: The (n−1)-skeleton of the unit lattice is Hⁿ-null
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ the set L_m := {x ∈ Euclid P : there is a finite set s of coordinates with P ≤ m + |s| and x_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ s} (the points with at least P − m integer coordinates) satisfies μHE[m+1](L_m) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), μHE[m + 1] {x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} = 0
